$comment: Derived from zipnative docs/assets/api.json (1.0.0). One row per export of the two entry points; docs/KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md section 8 maps every name to an MCP touchpoint (tool + input/output field) and tests/docs-consistency.test.ts may enforce it. kind is derived from the export signature. reach grades the row per the 1.0.0 coverage audit: "capability" = the behaviour behind the export is exercisable through a tool, "type" = re-exported (or aliased) upstream for typing only, "unexposed" = deliberately not reachable from a tool argument (via names the reason; describe_engine.unexposed reports the same list at runtime); via names the touchpoint.

exports.name: AddEntryOptions
exports.via: create_zip entries[] and modify_zip add/replace: compression, date, comment, externalAttributes | unixMode (mode bits → (S_IFREG|mode)<<16), extraFields[] { id, dataBase64 } (toAddEntryOptions in src/entry-spec.ts)

exports.name: ByteSource
exports.via: built internally by openArchiveSource (zipBase64 chunked / zipPath streamed) for scan_zip_forward and by fileChunks() for create_zip stream:true entries; an external ByteSource / ReadableStream is unexposed (JSON-RPC has no stream channel)

exports.name: CodecCompressOptions
exports.via: unexposed: only handed to an injected codec's compressSync, and no codec can be injected (registerCodec is unexposed)

exports.name: CreateZipOptions
exports.via: create_zip: order, defaultDate (ISO instant | 'now'), compression, comment, limits, strict (+ the always-installed diagnostics sink)

exports.name: DEFAULT_ZIP_LIMITS
exports.via: describe_engine.defaultLimits; the baseline resolveCallLimits / effectiveLimits merge over (src/limits.ts); quoted in the limits input description

exports.name: DeflateTier
exports.via: the value set of create_zip summary.deflateTier and describe_engine engine.deflateTier { default, deterministic } ('injected' never occurs in this server)

exports.name: EntryVerification
exports.via: read_zip_entry mode:'verify' → verification { ok, crcMatch, sizeMatch, localHeaderMatch }

exports.name: ExtractOptions
exports.via: extract_zip: rejectTraversal, rejectSymlinks, onDuplicate, filter (names/prefix/glob → filter(entry)), limits, strict

exports.name: ExtractedEntry
exports.via: extract_zip base64 mode rows (extractZip): path, entryName, index, sizeBytes, crc32, method, dataBase64

exports.name: ExtractedStreamEntry
exports.via: extract_zip dry-run plan (includeData:false) and file-mode rows (extractZipStream; stream() into the sandbox sink → filePath)

exports.name: FLAG_DATA_DESCRIPTOR
exports.via: decodeFlags() → flags.dataDescriptor on every EntryView row; viewFromHeader usesDataDescriptor (scan_zip_forward)

exports.name: FLAG_ENCRYPTED
exports.via: decodeFlags() → flags.encrypted on every EntryView row

exports.name: FLAG_STRONG_ENCRYPTION
exports.via: decodeFlags() → flags.strongEncryption on every EntryView row

exports.name: FLAG_UTF8
exports.via: decodeFlags() → flags.utf8; inspect_zip determinism.utf8Flags and check:'utf8-names'

exports.name: Inflator
exports.via: inflate_raw: push / finished / leftover / bytesConsumed / end → summary.bytesConsumed, leftover, finished

exports.name: IterateZipOptions
exports.via: scan_zip_forward: limits, strict + the diagnostics sink passed to iterateZipEntries

exports.name: METHOD_DEFLATE
exports.via: methodName() on EntryView rows, inspect_zip check:'deflate-only' / assert.method, inflate_raw method:'deflate', describe_engine.codecs

exports.name: METHOD_STORE
exports.via: methodName() on EntryView rows, inspect_zip check:'store-only' / assert.method, inflate_raw method:'store' (bounded pass-through), describe_engine.codecs

exports.name: OpenZipOptions
exports.via: inspect_zip.validate ('eager' default) and list_zip_entries.validate ('lazy' default); limits / strict / onDiagnostic on every random-access tool

exports.name: ReadEntryOptions
exports.via: read_zip_entry.verifyCrc → readEntry(entry, { verifyCrc }); { verifyCrc:false } on readEntryStream for a range

exports.name: StreamOptions
exports.via: create_zip.chunkSize → writer.stream({ chunkSize }) (file mode, 1 KiB … 16 MiB)

exports.name: StreamedZipEntry
exports.via: scan_zip_forward: header / data() (data:'verify'|'include') / skip() (data:'none', filtered-out and directory entries)

exports.name: StreamedZipHeader
exports.via: viewFromHeader() → scan_zip_forward.entries[] (isSymlink / usesZip64 / unixMode null; rawName → rawNameHex; descriptor headers carry zero sizes)

exports.name: VERSION
exports.via: describe_engine.engine.version; serverInfo.instructions and __serverMetadata.engineVersion; the cache key namespace (CACHE_API_VERSION); pins docs/data/*.json in the docs-consistency test

exports.name: VerifiedEntry
exports.via: verify_zip.entries[] (name, ok, crcMatch, sizeMatch, localHeaderMatch, skipped?: 'encrypted' | 'stream-only-codec'), selected by entries:'all'|'failed'|'skipped'|'none'

exports.name: VerifyZipOptions
exports.via: verify_zip.limits → { limits }

exports.name: ZipBaseErrorCode
exports.via: the 7 base-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (ZIP_API_MISUSE and ZIP_INTERNAL unreachable by design; ZIP_INPUT_TOO_LARGE needs > 2 GiB in one deflate call, above the inline caps)

exports.name: ZipCodec
exports.via: unexposed: a codec is executable code; JSON cannot carry one and zipnative ships no extra codec by policy (the built-in store/deflate codecs are visible through describe_engine.codecs)

exports.name: ZipCommonOptions
exports.via: strict and limits on every engine-touching tool (EngineOptionsShape); onDiagnostic is unexposed — the server always installs its own sink so every result carries diagnostics[]

exports.name: ZipCompressionOptions
exports.via: compression { method: 'store'|'deflate', level 0–9, deterministic } at archive level (create_zip, modify_zip) and per entry

exports.name: ZipDataError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'data' with entryName and { expectedCrc, actualCrc } (8-hex)

exports.name: ZipDataErrorCode
exports.via: the 5 data-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (all reachable)

exports.name: ZipDiagnostic
exports.via: createDiagnosticSink() → DiagnosticRow { code, severity, message, entryName? } in every result's diagnostics[] (dedup by code + entryName, cap 200)

exports.name: ZipDiagnosticCode
exports.via: ZIP_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES → describe_engine.diagnosticCodes; diagnostics[].code; inspect_zip.prependedData / multipleEocd derived from two of them

exports.name: ZipDiagnosticHandler
exports.via: the sink's onDiagnostic (src/diagnostics.ts)

exports.name: ZipEntry
exports.via: viewFromEntry() → EntryView rows (list_zip_entries, read_zip_entry.entry, extract_zip) incl. rawNameHex / commentHex; inspect_zip statistics and determinism verdict; modify_zip planning

exports.name: ZipError
exports.via: mapZipError() instanceof root; err.code → _meta.error.code verbatim, err.name → _meta.error.data.engineError

exports.name: ZipErrorCode
exports.via: ZIP_ERROR_CLASS satisfies Record<ZipErrorCode, …> compile-time guard (the codes reach _meta.error.code and describe_engine.errorCodes)

exports.name: ZipExtraField
exports.via: read: extraFields[] { id, idHex, name, length, dataBase64? } on EntryView rows (list_zip_entries.includeExtraData adds the payload); write: extraFields[] { id, dataBase64 } on create_zip entries and modify_zip add/replace (id 0x0001 refused)

exports.name: ZipFormatError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'parse' ('input' for the two entry-name codes)

exports.name: ZipFormatErrorCode
exports.via: the 13 format-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (all reachable through the hostile fixtures)

exports.name: ZipLimitError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'limit' with { limit, configured, observed }

exports.name: ZipLimitErrorCode
exports.via: the 2 limit-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (ZIP_LIMIT_INVALID pre-empted by the Zod limits schema)

exports.name: ZipLimits
exports.via: the limits input (eight keys) on every engine-touching tool; describe_engine.defaultLimits; the operator ceilings ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES / ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES bound three of the keys

exports.name: ZipModifier
exports.via: modify_zip.operations[]: addEntry (add), replaceEntry (replace), removeEntry (remove), renameEntry (rename), setComment (setComment), save (mode:'append') / saveCompact (mode:'compact'); .reader is unexposed (the input itself)

exports.name: ZipModifierOptions
exports.via: modify_zip: compression, defaultDate (new payloads), limits, strict

exports.name: ZipReader
exports.via: entries() (every read tool), getEntry (read_zip_entry.name), readEntry / readEntryStream / readEntryRaw (read_zip_entry data / range / raw), verifyEntry (read_zip_entry mode:'verify'), entryCount / isZip64 / comment (inspect_zip, list_zip_entries; comment → commentHex); .bytes only for modify_zip summary.noOp — unexposed as a field

exports.name: ZipSecurityError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'security' with entryName

exports.name: ZipSecurityErrorCode
exports.via: the 6 security-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (all reachable)

exports.name: ZipUnsupportedError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'unsupported' with { feature }

exports.name: ZipUnsupportedErrorCode
exports.via: the 6 unsupported-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_ZIP64_STREAMING needs a streamed sourcePath > 4 GiB)

exports.name: ZipUnsupportedFeature
exports.via: _meta.error.data.feature ('zipcrypto' | 'strong-encryption' | 'multi-disk' | 'zip64-streaming' | 'cd-less-descriptor' | 'method:<n>')

exports.name: ZipVerificationReport
exports.via: the verify_zip result body: ok, error { code, message } | null, entryCount, entries, diagnostics (+ the wrapper's verifiedCount / failedCount / skippedCount / entriesTruncated)

exports.name: ZipWriter
exports.via: create_zip.entries[] → add / addDirectory (directory:true) / addStream (stream:true) / toBytes (base64 mode) / stream({ chunkSize }) (file mode or when an entry is streamed); the comment via CreateZipOptions.comment

exports.name: activeDeflateTier
exports.via: create_zip summary.deflateTier (activeDeflateTier(compression.deterministic === true)); describe_engine engine.deflateTier { default, deterministic }

exports.name: crc32
exports.via: compute_crc32 (dataBase64 | text | sourcePath streamed in 1 MiB chunks; seed chaining; expect → matches)

exports.name: createInflator
exports.via: inflate_raw method:'deflate' — the resumable bounded path (maxOutput mandatory) fed in 64 KiB chunks

exports.name: createZip
exports.via: create_zip (sequential writer)

exports.name: createZipModifier
exports.via: modify_zip over the opened reader

exports.name: extractZip
exports.via: extract_zip base64 mode with includeData:true (in-memory extractor)

exports.name: extractZipStream
exports.via: extract_zip plan phase (includeData:false = dry run) and file mode (streamed into the sandbox sink)

exports.name: getCodec
exports.via: inflate_raw numeric method (decompressSync), methodName() on EntryView rows, describe_engine.codecs[] { sync, stream }

exports.name: getUnixMode
exports.via: unixMode (four octal digits or null) on every central-directory EntryView row (list_zip_entries, read_zip_entry.entry)

exports.name: initNodeZipCodecs
exports.via: unexposed: a startup concern — ensureEngineReady() (src/engine.ts) calls it once before serving so every sync codec path (the worker pool included) runs on the node-zlib tier; not a tool input

exports.name: isSymlinkEntry
exports.via: isSymlink on every EntryView row; inspect_zip.symlinkCount and check:'no-symlinks'

exports.name: iterateZipEntries
exports.via: scan_zip_forward (the forward reader over the ByteSource built by openArchiveSource)

exports.name: openZip
exports.via: inspect_zip, list_zip_entries, read_zip_entry, extract_zip (index pre-flight), modify_zip — every random-access tool

exports.name: registerCodec
exports.via: unexposed: a codec is executable code; JSON cannot carry one and zipnative ships no extra codec by policy — inflate_raw with a method beyond 0/8 answers ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_METHOD

exports.name: sanitizeEntryPath
exports.via: sanitize_entry_paths.results[].sanitized; sanitizedPath on every EntryView row; inspect_zip.unsafeNameCount / check:'safe-names'; extract_zip skipped list (rejectTraversal:false) and emptyDirectories

exports.name: setDeflateImpl
exports.via: unexposed: runtime code injection; the server owns tier selection and reports it (create_zip summary.deflateTier, describe_engine engine.deflateTier)

exports.name: setInflateImpl
exports.via: unexposed: runtime code injection; the reader paths run on the tier initNodeZipCodecs selected

exports.name: verifyZip
exports.via: verify_zip (the report returned verbatim; never isError for an archive problem)

exports.name: ByteSource
exports.via: the worker subpath re-exports the root declaration; the server imports ByteSource from the root entry only

exports.name: ParallelZipOptions
exports.via: create_zip.parallel { workers (≤ ZIPNATIVE_MCP_WORKERS), minWorkerJobSize, jobTimeout } + every CreateZipOptions field; workerUrl is unexposed (a path from a tool argument would point the worker at arbitrary code; the packaged worker resolves itself)

exports.name: ParallelZipWriter
exports.via: the create_zip writer under parallel (toBytes awaited; stream() in file mode); summary.parallel { requested, workers }

exports.name: StreamOptions
exports.via: the worker subpath re-exports the root declaration; the server imports StreamOptions from the root entry only (create_zip.chunkSize also applies under parallel)

exports.name: createParallelZip
exports.via: create_zip.parallel via dynamic import('zipnative/worker'); byte-identical to createZip per tier
